headline: Batman Star Stacy Keach Passes Away
post:
Veteran actor Stacy Keach has passed away at the age of 85 following a long battle with a heart condition, according to his wife Malgosia Keach. His impressive career spanned more than six decades across film, television, and the stage.

Comic book and animation fans will remember his memorable voice work in Batman: Mask of the Phantasm and Sin City: A Dame to Kill For, alongside numerous other iconic television and movie roles.

Further updates will follow as they become available.

#StacyKeach #Batman #InMemoriam
original_title: Stacy Keach, Star of Batman: Mask of the Phantasm, Prison Break, & More Dead at 85

headline: Marvel Mutants with Horrific Nightmares
post:
Not every X-Men ability is a walk in the park. According to Screen Rant, some comic book characters deal with mutations that function more like a curse than a gift. Take Bailey Hoskins, who can literally explode with force, but lacks a healing factor. That means activating his power causes his own death! Then there is Chamber, whose body was permanently altered by a blast of energy that left him without the ability to speak or breathe normally. Even classic heroes like Rogue faced immense early hardships when her touch put her first boyfriend into a comatose state. These intense stories prove that having incredible abilities often comes with a massive, terrifying personal cost. 🦇

Which X-Men power do you think would be the hardest to live with day-to-day?

original_title: 10 Marvel Mutants Whose Powers Are Actually Horrific Nightmares To Live With

headline: Six Million Dollar Man toys before Star Wars
post:
Before a galaxy far, far away took over toy aisles, Kenner found massive success with "The Six Million Dollar Man" action figures. According to ComicBook.com, the 1975 lineup featuring Steve Austin helped put the company on the map just before they secured the rights to George Lucas's blockbuster franchise. 

The original release included the Bionic Man complete with a telescoping eye and a removable piece of rubber skin showing bionic parts underneath. Later additions brought iconic villains like Maskatron and the highly collectible Bionic Bigfoot, which can fetch up to $1k today. These classic toys sparked a dedicated collector base that still thrives decades later.

Did you ever own any of these vintage bionic action figures?

#SixMillionDollarMan #StarWars #KennerToys
original_title: Before Star Wars, These Six Million Dollar Man Action Figures Were Kenner’s Biggest Hit
